title: JSON views without N+1 queries
summary: Return explicit fields with JsonResponse, handle missing rows, and load relations in one query.

scenario.briefing: The inventory endpoint is slow because each item loads its category separately, and a missing id crashes the detail route. Return explicit JSON fields, load the relation once, and answer missing rows with a 404.

objectives.description: Apply the taught syntax in a working file.
Review an artifact and identify the concrete risks.

Add select_related("category") before .all() in the list view.
Replace Item.objects.get with get_object_or_404 for the detail route.
Move the shared field dictionary into a helper so both views return the same shape.

misconceptions.description: Accessing a foreign key inside a loop without select_related.
misconceptions.testDescription: The list view loads each category with its item.
misconceptions.feedback: Each lazy access issues a query. select_related joins the related row into the original query.

misconceptions.testDescription: The detail view returns a 404 for a missing row.
misconceptions.feedback: A missing row raises DoesNotExist and becomes a 500. get_object_or_404 returns a 404 response.

misconceptions.description: Disabling CSRF on a session-authenticated POST view.
misconceptions.diagnostic: Approving a session-authenticated POST view that is marked csrf_exempt.
misconceptions.feedback: Session cookies travel automatically, so another site can submit the request. Keep CSRF enforcement or use token auth without cookie credentials.

sections.title: URLconf maps paths to views
sections.body: `path("items/<int:item_id>/", item_detail)` converts the URL segment to an int and calls the view with `item_id`. `get_object_or_404` queries the row and returns a 404 response when it does not exist, instead of raising an unhandled DoesNotExist.

sections.title: Relations are lazy
sections.body: Accessing `item.category` inside a loop issues one query per item, the N+1 pattern. `select_related("category")` joins the foreign key into the original query; `prefetch_related` handles many-to-many and reverse relations with a second batched query.

sections.title: Sessions and CSRF boundaries
sections.body: Django session cookies are sent automatically by the browser, so unsafe methods such as POST need a CSRF token. Mark a view `csrf_exempt` only for an API that authenticates with a token and does not rely on cookies. Read-only GET views must not change state.
